snippet.title: Portrait of a Torn | Release Date Annoucement | PS5
snippet.description:
Step into the shadows of a forsaken family home as Robert, a soldier returning to uncover decades of buried tragedy. Through haunting letters, hidden heirlooms, and interconnected rooms dripping with dread, piece together a tale of resentment, forced marriages, and unspeakable loss.

No jump scares – just pure atmospheric tension that lingers.

🌟 Key Features of Portrait of a Torn:
• 2-hour narrative journey through tuberculosis-era mystery
• Environmental puzzles & emotional storytelling
• Haunting sound design + evocative art direction

📅 LAUNCH: March 5, 2026 on PlayStation 5
👨‍💻 Developed by Indigo Studios
Wishlist Now: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014988
